directions.descriptionZh: 这是一个在陌生街区问路的场景。接下来我会扮演当地居民，你要礼貌说明目的地、确认路线，并在听懂后回应。
directions.missionZh: 完成询问目的地、确认方向和结束问路三个任务。

goals.prompt: Hi there! Can I help you find somewhere?
goals.example: Yes, please. How can I get to the train station?
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me where you would like to go.
goals.success: Of course. I can help you get there.

goals.prompt: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. Does that make sense?
goals.example: Yes. I go straight and then turn left.
goals.retry: That is okay. Try saying the directions back to me.
goals.success: Exactly. Go straight first, and then turn left.

goals.prompt: Would you like me to repeat the directions?
goals.example: No, thank you. I got it.
goals.retry: No worries. Please tell me whether you want me to repeat it.
goals.success: Great. Have a safe trip!

directions.redirect: Let us come back to finding your destination.
directions.completion: Great job! You asked for directions, confirmed the route, and ended the conversation politely.

pharmacy.descriptionZh: 这是一个在药店说明身体不适的场景。接下来我会扮演药剂师，你要描述症状、持续时间和过敏情况。
pharmacy.missionZh: 完成说明症状、说明持续时间和回答过敏情况三个任务。

goals.prompt: Hello. How can I help you today?
goals.example: I have a headache and a bad cough.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me what feels wrong.
goals.success: I am sorry you are not feeling well.
patterns: \b(?:i have|i(?:'ve| have) got|i feel|i am feeling)\b.*\b(?:headache|cough|cold|sore throat|fever|stomachache|pain|dizzy|nauseous|allergy)\b

goals.prompt: How long have you had these symptoms?
goals.example: I have had them for three days.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me how many hours, days, or weeks it has been.
goals.success: Thank you. That helps me understand the situation.
patterns: \b(?:today|yesterday|last night|this morning|a few days|for a while)\b
\b(?:it started|they started|i have had it|i have had them)\b.*\b(?:today|yesterday|ago|day|days|week|weeks)\b

goals.prompt: Do you have any allergies to medicine?
goals.example: No, I do not have any allergies.
goals.retry: That is okay. Please tell me yes or no, and name the medicine if you know it.
goals.success: Thank you. I will keep that in mind.
patterns: \b(?:no|none|nope|not that i know of|i do not|i don(?:'t| not))\b.*\b(?:allerg|medicine)?

pharmacy.redirect: Let us come back to choosing the right medicine for you.
pharmacy.completion: Well done! You explained your symptoms, their duration, and your allergy information clearly.

neighbour.descriptionZh: 这是一个第一次认识新邻居的场景。接下来我会扮演刚搬来的邻居，你要介绍自己、聊居住时间，并推荐附近的地点。
neighbour.missionZh: 完成自我介绍、说明居住时间和推荐附近地点三个任务。

goals.prompt: Hi! I just moved in next door. What is your name?
goals.example: Hi! I'm Alex. Nice to meet you.
goals.retry: No problem. Introduce yourself with your name.
goals.success: Nice to meet you! It is great to know a neighbour.

goals.prompt: How long have you lived in this neighbourhood?
goals.example: I have lived here for two years.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me when you moved here or how long you have lived here.
goals.success: That is good to know. You must know the area well.

goals.prompt: Is there a good cafe or shop nearby?
goals.example: Yes. There is a great cafe around the corner.
goals.retry: No worries. Recommend one nearby place, or tell me there is not one.
goals.success: Thank you! I will check it out.
patterns: \b(?:there is|there['’]?s|you can try|you should visit|go to)\b.*\b(?:cafe|coffee shop|restaurant|park|supermarket|shop|pharmacy|gym)\b
\b(?:no|not really|i do not know|i don['’]?t know)\b

neighbour.redirect: Let us come back to getting to know each other as neighbours.
neighbour.completion: Wonderful! You introduced yourself, shared how long you have lived here, and recommended a local place.

coffee.descriptionZh: 这是一个咖啡店点单的场景。接下来我会做点餐员，你是来买咖啡的顾客。你不需要照搬示例，只要回答符合点单语境就算正确。
coffee.missionZh: 完成选择饮品、选择杯型和选择堂食或外带三个任务。
coffee.freeTalkZh: 像真实点单一样自由说：美式、拿铁或其他饮品都可以。一句话里同时说出饮品、杯型和堂食/外带，会一次完成多个任务。

goals.prompt: Hi! What can I get for you?
goals.example: I'd like an Americano.
goals.retry: No problem. Let us try again. What drink would you like?
goals.success: Great choice!
patterns: \b(?:i['’]?d like|i would like|can i get|could i get|can i have|could i have|i(?:['’]?ll| will) have|i want)\b.*\b(?:americano|latte|cappuccino|espresso|mocha|coffee|tea|matcha|flat white|cold brew|hot chocolate)\b

goals.prompt: What size would you like?
goals.example: Can I get a medium?
goals.retry: No problem. Let us try again. Would you like a small, medium, or large?
goals.success: Perfect. I have the size.
patterns: \b(?:can i get|could i get|can i have|could i have|i['’]?d like|i would like|make it)\b.*\b(?:small|medium|large|big|regular|tall|grande|venti|xl|extra large)\b

goals.prompt: Is that for here or to go?
goals.example: To go, please.
goals.retry: No problem. Let us try again. Is it for here or to go?
goals.success: Perfect. Your order is ready.
patterns: \b(?:i['’]?ll have it|i will have it|make it)\b.*\b(?:here|to go|takeaway|take out)\b

coffee.redirect: Let us come back to your coffee order.
coffee.completion: Great! You chose a drink, a size, and whether to have it here or take it to go. Your order is complete.

restaurant.descriptionZh: 这是一个在餐厅点餐的场景。接下来我会扮演服务员，你要选择主食、饮品，并确认是否还需要其他东西。
restaurant.missionZh: 完成选择主食、选择饮品和结束点单三个任务。

goals.prompt: Are you ready to order?
goals.example: Yes, I'd like the grilled chicken, please.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me which main dish you would like.
goals.success: Excellent choice.
patterns: \b(?:i['’]?d like|i would like|i['’]?ll have|i will have|can i get|could i have)\b.*\b(?:chicken|pasta|steak|salad|burger|pizza|fish|soup|vegetarian)\b

goals.prompt: What would you like to drink?
goals.example: Could I have some sparkling water, please?
goals.retry: That is okay. Choose any drink you would enjoy.
goals.success: Certainly. I will bring that with your meal.
patterns: \b(?:i['’]?d like|i would like|i['’]?ll have|can i get|could i have)\b.*\b(?:water|juice|tea|coffee|cola|lemonade|wine|beer)\b

goals.prompt: Would you like anything else?
goals.example: No, thank you. That is all.
goals.retry: No worries. Tell me if you want something else or if that is all.
goals.success: Perfect. I will place your order now.
patterns: \b(?:no|nothing else|that is all|that['’]?s all|i am good|i['’]?m good)\b

restaurant.redirect: Let us come back to completing your restaurant order.
restaurant.completion: Excellent! You ordered a main dish, chose a drink, and completed the order naturally.

restaurant-problem.learnerRoleZh: 需要处理点单问题的顾客
restaurant-problem.descriptionZh: 这是一个在餐厅礼貌处理问题的场景。接下来我会扮演餐厅经理，你要说明问题、选择解决方式，并确认是否还需要帮助。
restaurant-problem.missionZh: 完成说明问题、选择解决方式和礼貌结束三个任务。

goals.prompt: I am sorry to hear that. What seems to be the problem?
goals.example: I'm afraid this is not what I ordered.
goals.retry: That is okay. Please explain what is wrong with your order.
goals.success: I understand. I am sorry about that.
patterns: \b(?:this is|it is|my food is|my order is)\b.*\b(?:wrong|cold|undercooked|overcooked|missing|salty|not fresh)\b
\b(?:not what i ordered|did not order|didn['’]?t order|ordered something else)\b
\b(?:i have been waiting|i['’]?ve been waiting|waited)\b.*\b(?:too long|minutes|hour)\b

goals.prompt: Would you like a replacement or a refund?
goals.example: A replacement would be great, please.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me whether you prefer a replacement or a refund.
goals.success: Of course. I will arrange that for you.
patterns: \b(?:i would like|i['’]?d like|i prefer|please give me|can i have)\b.*\b(?:replacement|refund|new one|another dish|money back)\b
\b(?:replace it|cancel it|take it off the bill|give me my money back)\b

goals.prompt: Is there anything else I can help you with?
goals.example: No, that is all. Thank you for your help.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me if you need more help or if everything is settled.
goals.success: Thank you for your patience.
patterns: \b(?:no|nothing else|that is all|that['’]?s all|everything is fine|we are good)\b

restaurant-problem.redirect: Let us come back to solving the problem with your order.
restaurant-problem.completion: Well done! You explained the problem, chose a solution, and closed the conversation politely.

clothes.descriptionZh: 这是一个在服装店购物的场景。接下来我会扮演店员，你要说出想找的衣服、需要的尺码，并决定是否试穿。
clothes.missionZh: 完成选择衣服、选择尺码和回应试穿邀请三个任务。

goals.prompt: Hi! Can I help you find anything?
goals.example: Yes, I am looking for a blue shirt.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me what kind of clothing you want.
goals.success: Certainly. Let me show you some options.

goals.prompt: What size would you like?
goals.example: Do you have it in a medium?
goals.retry: That is okay. Choose a size such as small, medium, or large.
goals.success: Great. I will find that size for you.

goals.prompt: Would you like to try it on?
goals.example: Yes, please. Where is the fitting room?
goals.retry: No worries. Tell me yes or no.
goals.success: Of course. The fitting room is over there.
patterns: \b(?:no|not now|i will take it|i['’]?ll take it)\b

clothes.redirect: Let us come back to finding the right clothes for you.
clothes.completion: Great work! You chose an item, gave your size, and handled the fitting-room question.

checkout.descriptionZh: 这是一个在超市结账的场景。接下来我会扮演收银员，你要回答是否需要袋子、选择支付方式，并回答是否需要小票。
checkout.missionZh: 完成购物袋、支付方式和小票三个结账任务。

goals.prompt: Would you like a bag?
goals.example: Yes, please. I would like one bag.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me yes or no about the bag.
goals.success: Certainly.
patterns: \b(?:no|nope|no bag|i have my own|i brought my own)\b

goals.prompt: How would you like to pay?
goals.example: Can I pay by card?
goals.retry: That is okay. Choose card, cash, contactless, or another payment method.
goals.success: Of course. Please use the card reader.

goals.prompt: Would you like your receipt?
goals.example: Yes, please. I need the receipt.
goals.retry: No worries. Tell me whether you want the receipt.
goals.success: Here you are. Have a nice day!

checkout.redirect: Let us come back to finishing your checkout.
checkout.completion: Nice work! You chose a bag, paid for your shopping, and handled the receipt question.

returns.descriptionZh: 这是一个退换商品的场景。接下来我会扮演客服人员，你要说明退什么、解释原因，并选择退款或换货。
returns.missionZh: 完成说明商品、说明退换原因和选择处理方式三个任务。

goals.prompt: What would you like to return today?
goals.example: I would like to return this jacket.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me which item you are returning.
goals.success: Certainly. Let me take a look.

goals.prompt: Could you tell me why you would like to return it?
goals.example: It does not work properly.
goals.retry: That is okay. Explain what is wrong with the item.
goals.success: I understand the problem.
patterns: \b(?:changed my mind|not what i expected|do not need it|don['’]?t need it)\b

goals.prompt: Would you like a refund or an exchange?
goals.example: I would like an exchange, please.
goals.retry: No problem. Choose a refund or an exchange.
goals.success: Certainly. I will process that for you.
patterns: \b(?:i would like|i['’]?d like|i prefer|can i have|could i get)\b.*\b(?:refund|exchange|replacement|money back|store credit)\b

returns.redirect: Let us come back to your return request.
returns.completion: Excellent! You identified the item, explained the problem, and chose a suitable return option.

airport.descriptionZh: 这是一个机场值机的场景。接下来我会扮演航空公司工作人员，你要出示护照、说明托运行李，并选择座位。
airport.missionZh: 完成出示护照、说明行李和选择座位三个任务。

goals.prompt: May I see your passport, please?
goals.example: Of course. Here you are.
goals.retry: No problem. Hand me your passport with a short polite reply.
goals.success: Thank you. I have your booking.

goals.prompt: Are you checking any bags today?
goals.example: Yes. I have one suitcase to check.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me how many bags you are checking, or say none.
goals.success: Great. Please place the bag on the scale.

goals.prompt: Would you prefer an aisle or a window seat?
goals.example: A window seat, please.
goals.retry: No worries. Choose an aisle seat, a window seat, or say you have no preference.
goals.success: Perfect. I have assigned your seat.
patterns: \b(?:i prefer|i would like|i['’]?d like|can i have)\b.*\b(?:aisle|window|middle)\b
\b(?:no preference|any seat|either is fine|does not matter|doesn['’]?t matter)\b

airport.redirect: Let us come back to completing your airport check-in.
airport.completion: You did it! You presented your passport, checked your luggage, and chose a seat.

hotel.descriptionZh: 这是一个酒店入住的场景。接下来我会扮演前台，你要确认预订、提供预订姓名，并选择房卡数量。
hotel.missionZh: 完成确认预订、提供姓名和选择房卡数量三个任务。

goals.prompt: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?
goals.example: Yes, I have a reservation.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me whether you have a booking.
goals.success: Great. I will look it up.

goals.prompt: What name is the booking under?
goals.example: It is under the name Alex Chen.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me the name on the booking.
goals.success: Thank you. I found your reservation.

goals.prompt: Would you like one room key or two?
goals.example: Two room keys, please.
goals.retry: No worries. Choose one key or two keys.
goals.success: Certainly. Here are your room keys.
patterns: \b(?:i would like|i['’]?d like|can i have|could i get)\b.*\b(?:one|two|three|extra)\b.*\bkeys?\b

hotel.redirect: Let us come back to completing your hotel check-in.
hotel.completion: Great! You confirmed your reservation, gave the booking name, and chose your room keys.

car-rental.descriptionZh: 这是一个租车柜台的场景。接下来我会扮演租车工作人员，你要选择车型、说明租期，并决定是否购买保险。
car-rental.missionZh: 完成选择车型、说明租用时间和选择保险三个任务。

goals.prompt: What kind of car are you looking for?
goals.example: I would prefer a compact automatic car.
goals.retry: No problem. Choose a car type or describe what you need.
goals.success: Good choice. We have that type available.

goals.prompt: How many days will you need the car?
goals.example: I will need it for five days.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me how many days or weeks you need it.
goals.success: Great. I have noted the rental period.
patterns: \b(?:for the weekend|over the weekend|a few days)\b

goals.prompt: Would you like full insurance coverage?
goals.example: Yes, I would like full coverage, please.
goals.retry: No worries. Tell me whether you want full coverage, basic coverage, or no extra insurance.
goals.success: Certainly. I have added your insurance choice.

car-rental.redirect: Let us come back to arranging your rental car.
car-rental.completion: Excellent! You selected a car, set the rental period, and made an insurance choice.

interview.learnerRoleZh: 正在参加面试的求职者
interview.descriptionZh: 这是一个求职面试的场景。接下来我会扮演面试官，你要介绍自己、说明求职动机，并讲出一项个人优势。
interview.missionZh: 完成自我介绍、说明应聘动机和说明个人优势三个任务。

goals.prompt: Could you tell me a little about yourself?
goals.example: I am a product designer with three years of experience.
goals.retry: Take your time. Tell me your role, studies, or experience.
goals.success: Thank you. That is a clear introduction.

goals.prompt: Why are you interested in this role?
goals.example: I am interested because I enjoy solving customer problems.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me what attracts you to the role or company.
goals.success: That is a thoughtful reason.

goals.prompt: What is one of your strengths?
goals.example: One of my strengths is communicating clearly with a team.
goals.retry: That is okay. Name one skill or quality you are good at.
goals.success: That strength would be valuable in this role.
patterns: \b(?:my strength is|one of my strengths is|i am|i['’]?m)\b.*\b(?:communicat|teamwork|problem solving|organi[sz]ed|creative|reliable|patient|leadership)\b
\b(?:i am good at|i['’]?m good at|i excel at)\b.*\b(?:communicat|working with|solving|planning|leading|organising|organizing)\b

interview.redirect: Let us come back to the interview question.
interview.completion: Well done! You introduced your background, explained your motivation, and described a professional strength.

classmate.descriptionZh: 这是一个在教室里认识同学的场景。接下来我会扮演同学，你要回应座位问题、说明自己是不是新生，并聊聊所学内容。
classmate.missionZh: 完成回应座位、说明新生身份和介绍所学内容三个任务。

goals.prompt: Hi! Is this seat taken?
goals.example: No, it is free. You can sit here.
goals.retry: No problem. Tell me whether the seat is free or taken.
goals.success: Thanks! I will sit here.

goals.prompt: Are you new here too?
goals.example: Yes, this is my first week.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me whether you are new here.
goals.success: Me too! It is nice to meet another new student.
patterns: \b(?:no|not really|i am not|i['’]?m not)\b.*\b(?:new|second year|been here|returning)?\b

goals.prompt: What are you studying?
goals.example: I am studying English and product design.
goals.retry: No worries. Name a subject, course, or major you study.
goals.success: That sounds interesting!
patterns: \b(?:my major is|i major in|my course is)\b.*[a-z]

classmate.redirect: Let us come back to getting to know each other as classmates.
classmate.completion: Nice work! You handled the seat question, shared whether you are new, and talked about your studies.

project-update.learnerRoleZh: 汇报项目进度的团队成员
project-update.learnerRoleEn: a team member giving a project update
project-update.descriptionZh: 这是一个工作进度汇报的场景。接下来我会扮演团队负责人，你要说明当前进度、风险或阻碍，并说出下一步计划。
project-update.missionZh: 完成进度、阻碍和下一步计划三个汇报任务。

goals.prompt: How is the project coming along?
goals.example: We are on track, and the first phase is complete.
goals.retry: Take your time. Tell me what is complete and whether the project is on track.
goals.success: Thanks. That gives me a clear picture of the progress.
patterns: \b(?:we are|we['’]?re|the project is|it is|it['’]?s)\b.*\b(?:on track|ahead of schedule|behind schedule|in progress|almost done|delayed)\b

goals.prompt: Is anything blocking you right now?
goals.example: We are waiting for customer feedback, but there are no major risks.
goals.retry: No problem. Name one blocker or say that there are no blockers.
goals.success: Understood. We can plan around that.
patterns: \b(?:the blocker is|the main risk is|we have|there is|there['’]?s)\b.*\b(?:issue|problem|delay|dependency|approval|resource|time|data)\b

goals.prompt: What will you do next?
goals.example: Next, I will finish testing and send the update tomorrow.
goals.retry: That is okay. Tell me one action you will take next and, if possible, when.
goals.success: Great. That sounds like a clear next step.
patterns: \b(?:i will|i['’]?ll|we will|we['’]?ll|i am going to|we are going to)\b.*\b(?:finish|test|review|send|deliver|meet|update|prepare|complete)\b

project-update.redirect: Let us come back to the project update.
project-update.completion: Excellent update! You covered the current status, the blockers, and the next step clearly.
